profile.initialization: Fresh parameters, matched within dataset/seed; original T24 fixed-corner optical geometry
profile.uniform_half_filter: In each of the four experts project only cells with even row+column; the complementary checkerboard cells transmit the modulated field directly.

fiber_model.location: immediately following the selected expert phase screen, prior to joint free-space propagation and OEO

profile.selection: Highest full VAL correct count, then lowest VAL cross entropy, then earliest epoch. TEST is diagnostic only.
profile.interpretation: Matched trainable parameters, examples and updates. Fiber count, effective optical rank, insertion loss and numerical operation count change among the arms. Two training seeds; mixed diagonals are counterbalanced across them. Scalar coherent simulation.

accuracy_units: percent, with comparisons in percentage points
optical_units: Fractions, equal-weight means over split images; pre/post powers refer to unit incident power before fiber projection and OEO. Conditional transmittance is ratio of summed post/pre powers.
selection: Best VAL, then lower VAL CE, then earliest exact tie; TEST is diagnostic.
stability: T24 VAL-only diagnostic at E180 on the actual fixed-budget T25 trajectory.
